name: Delta Trader
teaser: Autism Headquarters has announced a new trader that will be used for integrating my future mods into.
description_html:
I wanted to do something similar to MoxoPixel’s Painter so I don’t flood traders with custom items.

This trader *has* base game items and 4 loyalty levels.

All item mods that I make from this point forward will use this trader. I’ll be making this a requirement for the Arisaka Mount when I get the textures finished and everything finalized.

Screenshots of the assort are below.

Massive thanks to AcidPhantasm for helping me throughout this and checking my autism when I messed something up.

***IF YOU HAVE PROBLEMS, MAKE SURE TO INCLUDE LOGS SO I CAN FIND THE ISSUE***

And remember y’all, rizz’m with the tis’m
